content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?History In Pictures's PostHistory In Pictures Verified account4d · Shared with PublicLester Martinez has made history, becoming Guatemala’s first-ever boxing champion after capturing the WBC super middleweight interim title. This is a massive moment not just for him, but for an entire country that has never seen one of its own reach this level in boxing.
